name: starwork-multiagent-workflow-next
description: Experimental Codex plugin adapter for StarWork MultiAgent Workflow Next.

interface.shortDescription: Design and run StarWork MultiAgent next workflows from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Experimental Codex plugin adapter for StarWork MultiAgent Workflow Next. It bundles the $starworkMultiagentNext Skill and references for Codex-side discovery and explicit triggering. StarWork CLI @next is still required; project facts, lane bindings, request records, and workflow run state remain in the StarWork workspace.
defaultPrompt: Use $starworkMultiagentNext to check this StarWork workspace, then help me design a MultiAgent workflow. Do not start the workflow until I confirm.
Use $starworkMultiagentNext to inspect the confirmed workflow definition and show the next route preflight before any delivery.
Use $starworkMultiagentNext to explain whether this workspace is ready for StarWork MultiAgent Workflow Next.
